sections.heading: 1. After your session
lines: ① Drink water to thirst, same as usual.
② An easy 10-minute walk to loosen up.
③ Mild tenderness usually settles in 1–2 days.
④ Too firm? Tell your therapist next time.

caption:
"Drink lots of water to flush out the toxins." Momo heard it after her massage, too.

It's a popular idea, but research doesn't support it. Massage doesn't release a wave of toxins, and your liver and kidneys handle waste around the clock. Feeling a bit tender or tired the next day is common and usually passes within a day or two.

A glass of water is still fine. It's just ordinary hydration, so drink to thirst.

What remedial massage can do is ease muscle tension and help you move more comfortably, especially alongside exercise. Our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio keep expectations realistic. Book online via the link in bio.
